d: US President Donald Trump has claimed credit for Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO, saying he personally convinced the company's board to reinstate him. In an interview with CNBC, Trump said he spoke directly and indirectly with board members and helped secure the decision. Nvidia's board reversed its earlier position and unanimously approved Huang's return. Trump also said the US government found no evidence of wrongdoing by Huang and assured the board that his reinstatement posed no national security risk.
